reports.weather: Light rain outside; interior work area dry at start
reports.work_planned: Remove water-damaged concrete flooring and prepare substrate for replacement.
reports.work_completed: Removed approximately 18 m2 of flooring in Room B104. Debris placed in designated container. Exposed substrate photographed.
reports.materials_equipment: Concrete saw, breaker, dust extraction, debris cart
reports.issue_or_update: Water damage was observed near the east wall. The source has not been confirmed. No standing water remained at the start of the shift.
reports.schedule_status: Removal is progressing; substrate inspection required before replacement pour.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: CO-01 referenced; no RFI number listed
reports.action_required: GC to confirm removal boundary and arrange substrate inspection before pour preparation.
reports.supporting_evidence: Photos B104-0511-01 to B104-0511-04 listed; not attached in this synthetic record

reports.work_planned: Coordinate repair scope and confirm area ready for replacement concrete.
reports.work_completed: Daily coordination walk completed. Superintendent noted that the flooring removal area appeared ready for base preparation.
reports.issue_or_update: The report says the area is ready for base preparation, but does not record a substrate inspection, acceptance, or sign-off.
reports.schedule_status: Base preparation may proceed, subject to confirmation of inspection requirements.
reports.action_required: Confirm whether the substrate inspection has occurred and record acceptance before the pour.

reports.work_planned: Complete base preparation and place replacement concrete if area is released.
reports.work_completed: Base preparation completed over approximately 18 m2. No concrete placed.
reports.issue_or_update: Crew was told verbally at 07:20 that the area was cleared to proceed. No written release or inspection record was available at the workface.
reports.schedule_status: Pour postponed pending written confirmation of substrate acceptance and approved placement details.
reports.action_required: GC/Quality Inspector to issue written release and confirm RFI-017 response status.
reports.responsible_party: General Contractor / Quality Inspector / Design Team
reports.quantity_or_measurement: 18 m2 base preparation; 0 m3 concrete placed
reports.supporting_evidence: Crew foreman notes verbal instruction; no signed inspection form attached

reports.work_planned: Resolve inspection status and coordinate concrete placement.
reports.work_completed: Coordination call held with concrete subcontractor. Superintendent's notes state: 'Inspection passed this morning.'
reports.issue_or_update: No inspector name, inspection time, checklist, or written acceptance is referenced. The subcontractor's report for the same day states that written release was still outstanding at 15:30.
reports.schedule_status: Report indicates inspection passed; subcontractor records indicate pour remains on hold.
reports.action_required: Reconcile inspection status with the inspector and subcontractor; circulate the signed release and confirm whether RFI-017 is answered.
reports.supporting_evidence: Call notes only; no inspection record attached

reports.work_planned: Place replacement concrete after receipt of approved release and mix details.
reports.work_completed: No concrete placed. Crew completed edge cleaning and staged reinforcement materials outside the work area.
reports.materials_equipment: Reinforcement materials staged; concrete pump not mobilized
reports.issue_or_update: At 10:15, foreman checked with the GC. Written inspection release had not been received. RFI-017 asks whether the replacement slab should match the original thickness or revised detail; no response was available to the crew.
reports.schedule_status: Pour postponed for a second shift. Crew reassigned for part of the afternoon.
reports.action_required: Issue inspection release and provide written response to RFI-017 before rescheduling the pour.
reports.responsible_party: General Contractor / Quality Inspector / Design Team
reports.supporting_evidence: Foreman log; no formal response attached

reports.work_planned: Review RFI and confirm repair scope.
reports.work_completed: RFI-017 reviewed internally. Engineer's note says 'use original detail' but the response was not transmitted through the formal RFI system.
reports.issue_or_update: Internal note may be interpreted as a decision, but there is no formally issued response or confirmation that the subcontractor received it.
reports.schedule_status: Subcontractor may remain on hold until formal response is distributed.
reports.action_required: Issue the formal RFI response, confirm receipt, and identify the applicable drawing revision.
reports.supporting_evidence: Internal engineering note; formal response not attached

reports.work_completed: Inspection completed at 08:10. Substrate accepted for placement subject to using the approved slab detail and documenting reinforcement placement. Signed checklist recorded as QC-B104-0514.
reports.issue_or_update: The signed checklist confirms substrate acceptance, but does not resolve the slab thickness question in RFI-017.
reports.schedule_status: Substrate inspection closed; pour still depends on design clarification and reinforcement verification.
reports.action_required: Design Team to issue formal slab detail; subcontractor to request reinforcement inspection before placement.

reports.work_planned: Place replacement concrete after design and inspection release.
reports.work_completed: Reinforcement placed over the prepared area. No concrete placed.
reports.issue_or_update: Crew received a message from the GC saying 'detail should be the same as before.' The message did not identify a drawing number or revision, and RFI-017 still appeared open in the system.
reports.schedule_status: Pour not started. Reinforcement inspection requested but not yet completed.
reports.action_required: Confirm approved drawing revision and complete reinforcement inspection before placement.
reports.responsible_party: General Contractor / Design Team / Quality Inspector
reports.supporting_evidence: Message referenced but not attached; no reinforcement inspection record

reports.work_planned: Coordinate concrete placement and adjacent trade access.
reports.work_completed: Concrete placement completed. Delivery tickets list 4.2 m3 supplied. Pour began at 09:05 and finishing was completed by 12:40. Adjacent electrical subcontractor was notified to avoid the area until protection was removed.
reports.materials_equipment: Concrete pump; delivery tickets CT-771 and CT-772
reports.issue_or_update: Report states the pour used the approved detail, but does not cite the drawing revision or attach the formal RFI-017 response. Reinforcement inspection reference is listed as RI-B104-0515.
reports.schedule_status: Placement completed; curing/protection and strength-test follow-up remain in progress.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: CO-01; RFI-017 listed as 'resolved' by superintendent; RI-B104-0515
reports.action_required: Attach formal RFI response and reinforcement inspection record; maintain curing/protection; notify adjacent trades when access is safe.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: 4.2 m3 delivered; placed quantity not separately measured
reports.supporting_evidence: Delivery tickets referenced; RFI response not attached

reports.work_planned: Complete electrical rough-in in corridor adjacent to concrete repair area.
reports.work_completed: Crew stopped work near Room B104 from 09:00 to 12:45 while concrete placement and finishing activities restricted access. Crew moved to another corridor and resumed work there.
reports.issue_or_update: The report records a temporary access restriction but does not identify who issued the restriction or whether the electrical foreman received advance notice.
reports.schedule_status: No full-shift delay reported; local work sequence changed.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: No RFI or change order referenced
reports.action_required: GC to confirm access notification procedure for adjacent trades and record any verified schedule impact.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Approximately 3 hours 45 minutes of restricted access
